chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
My father, peace be upon him, had two bondwomen who served him, and he gifted one of them to me.
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about an Imam عليه السلام gifting one of his bondwomen?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام states that his father عليه السلام had two bondwomen who attended to him, and that he gave one of them to him as a gift. The report is a brief narrative relevant to rulings concerning ownership and transfer of bondwomen.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "My father (as) had two bondwomans who served him, and he gifted one of them to me."
